dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, ṣe o lè fún mi ni aná? Nítorí mo fẹ́ jẹ́ kí a máa dára lọ́wọ́ nítan.
dialogue.translation: Please, can you give me an example? Because I want us to continue in a good way with the mind.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí mo ba rí, nítorí nkọ́kọ́ nítan lẹ́yìn ẹ̀yìn àwọn ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ lọ ní. Ṣe o gbà pé nítorí àwọn àgbàgbọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ lọ́wọ́?
dialogue.translation: As I see it, because the mind itself follows after the thoughts of your elders. Do you accept that many beliefs are at play?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo gbà pé àṣẹ́ nínú nítan rẹ̀ kú lọ púpọ̀. Tí a bá ti kíkọ̀, a kú ẹ̀rọ̀ nítan.
dialogue.translation: I accept that your process is very dead. If we continue, we will kill the mind's tool.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tó kúru! Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, bí a bá ti ṣe àwọn ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ lọ, a yẹ kí nítan rẹ̀ máa dára.
dialogue.translation: Even harsh! Yes, if we follow your elders, we must ensure your mind keeps improving.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣe o rí pé nítan kò lè fún mi ni àyọ̀? Nítorí ẹ̀rọ̀ nítan rẹ̀ kú lọ púpọ̀.
dialogue.translation: Do you see that the mind can't give me joy? Because your mind's tool is too dead.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo rí, ṣùgbọ́n bí nítan ba ti dára lọ́wọ́ àwọn ọgbọ́n rẹ̀, a yẹ kí a máa jẹ́ kíkọ̀.
dialogue.translation: I see, but if the mind becomes good with your elders, we must ensure we continue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ kí a máa jọ̀wọ́ sọ́dọ̀ àwọn àwọn ọgbọ́n. Nítorí nítan rẹ̀ kò lè fún mi ni ọ̀pẹ́lọ́rọ́.
dialogue.translation: I want us to please discuss with these elders. Because your mind can't give me clarity.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, kíkọ̀. Mo gbà pé nítan rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ẹ̀yìn àwọn ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ lọ ní. Ṣe o ṣe ẹ̀tọ́?
dialogue.translation: Please, continue. I accept that your mind follows after your elders. Did you understand?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo gbọ́ pé àwọn ọmọdé dé nínú ilé wa lọ́wọ̀rọ̀ pàtàkù. Jẹ́ kí a fún wọn ní ìdánilẹ̀gbẹ̀ àti àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba tí wọ́n sì wà nínú àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí.
dialogue.translation: I heard that the youth are protesting in our country at least. Let’s allow them to have their freedom and the support they need, which is also part of our responsibilities.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jẹ́wọ́, ṣé àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba ni pé a gbọ́ pé àwọn ọmọdé ń ṣe ìtọ́jú àtúnṣe ilé wa nínú ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí?
dialogue.translation: But, isn’t it the responsibility we heard them ask for? That they want to rebuild our country within these responsibilities?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ara wọn sì wà fún ìtọ́jú àti ìmọ̀lẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kíkọ́ kan ni wọn tó mọ̀ pé a gbọ́ ilera. Títí ìmọ̀lẹ̀ tó dára, a máa jẹ́ kí wọn ṣe ìtọ́jú ọkànrẹ̀rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: They have the support and resources, but there is a limit they should understand about rights. Until the system is fair, we should allow them to express themselves.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ràn pé a jẹ́ kí wọn lọ́wọ̀rọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kíkọ́ àti àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba ni a gbọ́ pé a fún wọn ní.
dialogue.translation: I agree we should allow them freedom, but the limits and responsibilities are what we should give them.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pàtàkù lọ́wọ̀rọ̀ lọ́wọ̀rọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kíkọ́ àti ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba ni a gbọ́ pé a máa lọ́wọ̀rọ̀ lọ́wọ̀rọ̀.
dialogue.translation: Freedom is important, but the limits and responsibilities are what we must uphold.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo wà ní ìrẹ̀̀lẹ̀ pé àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí lè ṣe àwọn ọmọdé jẹ́ ìtọ́jú àti ìmọ̀lẹ̀ láti ṣe ìtọ́jú ilé wa.
dialogue.translation: I am convinced that these responsibilities can help the youth become the support and light to rebuild our country.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo gbọ́ pé àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí ni àwọn ọmọdé púpọ̀ fún. Jọ́ wọn kí wọn ní àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí.
dialogue.translation: I heard that these responsibilities are what the youth also want. Let’s gather them so they can understand these responsibilities.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jẹ́ kí a jẹ́ kí wọn ṣe ìtọ́jú ọkànrẹ̀rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kíkọ́ kan lè ṣe àwọn ẹ̀rọ àti ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba mọ́.
dialogue.translation: Let’s allow them to express themselves, but a certain limit might be the tools and support they need.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ẹ̀ máa jẹ́ kí àwọn ọmọdé wà ní àwọn ìtọ́jú àti ìmọ̀lẹ̀ láti ṣe ìtọ́jú ilé wa. Àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba sì wà fún gbogbo àwọn ọjọ́.
dialogue.translation: You should let the youth have the support and resources to rebuild our country. The responsibilities are for every day.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo gbọ́ pé àwọn ọmọdé dé nínú ilé wa lọ́wọ̀rọ̀ pàtàkù.
key_phrases.translation: I heard that the youth are protesting in our country at least.

key_phrases.phrase: Jẹ́ kí a fún wọn ní ìdánilẹ̀gbẹ̀ àti àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba.
key_phrases.translation: Let’s allow them to have their freedom and the support they need.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo wà ní ìrẹ̀̀lẹ̀ pé àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí lè ṣe àwọn ọmọdé jẹ́ ìtọ́jú àti ìmọ̀lẹ̀.
key_phrases.translation: I am convinced that these responsibilities can help the youth become the support and light.

key_phrases.phrase: Jọ́ wọn kí wọn ní àwọn ìtọ́jú àwọn ìsọ̀gba yìí.
key_phrases.translation: Let’s gather them so they can understand these responsibilities.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wọn sì là nkan nínú ìròyìn tí kú lẹ́. Ṣe o lè ṣe afikún pẹ̀lú wọn?
dialogue.translation: They are spreading news that has faded already. Can you join them?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí a bá jọ́ fún ìrẹ̀wẹ̀ àti ìdírayá, a yẹ kúrò nínú ìròyìn tí a là.
dialogue.translation: If we gather for fairness and balance, we must stay away from spreading biased news.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dúpé, o tókè! Ṣé o fún mí ní ìtọ́jú láti jẹ́kí a lè ṣe ìdírayá?
dialogue.translation: Thanks, you're right! Will you provide me with guidance to ensure balance?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣe o tẹ́lé kí a ṣe ìrẹ̀wẹ̀? A tọ́jú sí àwọn ìròyìn tí a fà párẹ́ sílẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Did you realize earlier that we examine news that has been hidden?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: À! Wọn sì wà nínú ìròyìn wọ̀ọ̀nyẹ́. A yẹ kí wọn pẹ̀lú.
dialogue.translation: Ah! They are indeed in the news cycle. We must include them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lẹ́, a máa ṣe ìrẹ̀wẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìtọ́jú tí a kọ̀. Wọn yẹ kí a lè ṣe ìdírayá.
dialogue.translation: Now, we will do justice with the insight we have. They must let us achieve balance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o bá mi lọ sí àwọn àkọ̀kọ̀ ìròyìn tí a là sí nínú ọ̀sẹ̀? A yẹ kí wọn wà láti ìdírayá.
dialogue.translation: Will you go with me to the first news we spread during the week? They must be present for balance.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Báwo! A yẹ kí a wá àwọn ìròyìn tí a là sí pátápátá. Àmọ̀dẹ́!
dialogue.translation: Great! We must retrieve the news we spread exactly. Excellent!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dúpé pẹ̀lú! A yẹ kí àwọn ìròyìn tó wà nínú ọ̀sẹ̀ jẹ́ ìdírayá lọ́wọ̀ àti ìrẹ̀wẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Thanks as well! We must ensure the news in the week is fair in balance and justice.

key_phrases.phrase: Wọn sì là nkan nínú ìròyìn tí kú lẹ́.
key_phrases.translation: They are spreading news that has faded already.

key_phrases.phrase: A yẹ kí a lè ṣe ìdírayá.
key_phrases.translation: We must ensure we achieve balance.

key_phrases.phrase: Wọn yẹ kí a lè ṣe ìdírayá.

key_phrases.translation: We must ensure the news in the week is fair in balance and justice.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ìwọ tún ṣèlú àwọn ọkùnrin tí ó wọ̀nyí fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀lọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀ àwọn ọmọdé?
dialogue.translation: Are you leading the group of men who are talking to many young people near the children?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àti fúnfun ni a wí fún àwọn ọmọdé nípasẹ̀ àwọn ọkùnrin kún lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ẹranko.
dialogue.translation: And the light-skinned ones are talking to the children through the men who are crowded around the animals.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ìwọ kún fún àwọn ọkùnrin lọ́wọ̀ ìtọ́jú àwọn ẹranko?
dialogue.translation: Are you filling the men with the care of animals?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Àti tí a wí padà nípasẹ̀ àwọn ọmọdé, a sì mọ́ pé àwọn àwọn ẹranko tún dún lọ́.
dialogue.translation: Yes. And when we talk again through the children, we also know that the animals are getting better too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Núpé àwọn ọkùnrin wí fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀lọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀ àwọn ọmọdé nínú àwọn fààlọ̀ wọ̀nyí, bí a ti ṣèlú rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Moreover, the men are talking to many young people near the children in these issues, like you're leading them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àti tí àwọn ọmọdé bá ti dún, àwọn dàhùn lọ́dọ̀ wa nípa ẹ̀tọ́ àti bí àwọn ẹranko lè ṣe àtúnṣè.
dialogue.translation: And when the children get better, they respond to us about ethics and how animals can be modified.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹranko tí a ti yọ̀ sílẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìtọ́jú rẹ̀ lará wọn ni? Àti bí a ti wí lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé nípa àwọn ìtọ́jú rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: I want to know if the animals that we left in your care are doing well. And like we told the children about your care.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo wí fún àwọn ọmọdé pé àwọn ẹranko wọ̀nyí ni àwọn tóbi kún lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọkùnrin, àti àwọn kéré lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé.
dialogue.translation: I told the children that these animals are the large ones under the care of the men, and the small ones under the children.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé àwọn dàhùn rẹ̀ lọ́dọ̀ ìtọ́jú àti ìmọ̀ràn àwọn ẹranko yẹ́ fún àwọn ọmọdé?
dialogue.translation: Did your responses about the care and guidance of animals satisfy the children?

key_phrases.phrase: Ṣèlú àwọn ọkùnrin tí ó wọ̀nyí fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀lọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀ àwọn ọmọdé?
key_phrases.translation: Are you leading the group of men who are talking to many young people near the children?

key_phrases.phrase: Àwọn ẹranko tí a ti yọ̀ sílẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìtọ́jú rẹ̀ lará wọn ni?
key_phrases.translation: Are the animals that we left in your care doing well?

key_phrases.phrase: Àwọn tóbi kún lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọkùnrin, àti àwọn kéré lọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé.
key_phrases.translation: The large ones are under the care of the men, and the small ones under the children.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo fẹ́ mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹranko lè ṣe àtúnṣè?
key_phrases.translation: I want to know if the animals can be modified?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí a bá tẹ́lé àyọ̀ ọkàn ọmọdé tó dára, a sì yẹ̀ kí wọn mú ìdàràgbọn sílẹ̀.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé àyọ̀ ọkàn ọmọdé ni yín mú ìdàràgbọn sílẹ̀? Àwọn baba wa n pè̀lú pàtàkù yẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: Is it the advice of the young that you’re letting lead? Our elders have problems with that, right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pàtàkù kò sí dára, ṣé ẹ gbọ́? Àwọn ọkùnrin tan lọ́wọ́ àwọn obìnrin wà lẹ́sẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: There’s no problem in that, did you hear? The men have gone to where the women are.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh! Àwọn obìnrin tún wà lọ́dọ̀ ọkùnrin? Ṣé àṣẹ́ yín tún dára? Mi o mọ́.
dialogue.translation: Oh! The women are also with the men? Is your work also good? I don’t know.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dára pẹ̀lú, ṣé ẹ mọ́ pé àwọn obìnrin lè ṣèlú ìṣẹ́ àgbá? Àwọn obìnrin ni a ṣèlú fún ilé-ẹkọ́.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣe àwọn ọmọdé tún lè dára bí àwọn àgbà? Àwọn àgbà nùkan wa lọ́wọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé ní àkẹ́kà.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: I think we should think about giving the authorities flexibility in how they handle justice in our country. Do you agree that flexibility is a good thing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dára, mo dúró lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lé. Èyìnkúlé ọ̀nà yìí yẹ̀ kó wà nílé ìjọba. Ṣe o le pẹ̀lé pé ẹ̀yìnkúlé yìí nlá jọ̀wọ́?
dialogue.translation: Okay, let me explain carefully. The current system needs improvement in government hands. Can you explain why this system is so large?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo ṣe pé àwọn ọnà tí a n wọ̀nyí sì nlé. Kó sì dé ọ̀nà tí a fún ẹ̀yìnkúlé fún ìtọ́jú àwọn ti o ní ìbàjẹ́ lọ́wọ̀.
dialogue.translation: I think these methods are outdated. They should also provide the authorities with tools to handle those who have committed crimes.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Báwo l'ó ṣe, ṣe a lè wá àyọ̀ sí àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n kú ní ìdájọ̀? Ṣe a lè bà wọn lé ẹ̀rọ àgbàlagbà?
dialogue.translation: How then can we reform the men who died in prison? Can we instead rehabilitate them?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A o ṣelé nípa àwọn ọkùnrin tí a kú, torí pé àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n jẹ́ kún lára lẹ́yìn ìdájọ̀ ní kún ẹ̀tọ̀.
dialogue.translation: We shouldn't focus on the dead men, because the people who survive prison often have trauma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dára, mo fẹ́ran pé a máa wá àwọn ìtọ̀jú tí a le fún àwọn ènìyàn lọ́wọ̀ gbàgbọ́ oríṣiríṣi.
dialogue.translation: Okay, I agree that we should find rehabilitation methods that truly help people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo wà pé àwọn ìdájọ̀ mẹ́ta ni a lè fún ìtọ̀jú àwọn ènìyàn. Aláì ṣe tí a bà fún ìtọ̀jú sí àwọn ìdájọ̀ méjì kan nínú àgbẹ̀kọ̀wé.
dialogue.translation: I think we can provide rehabilitation for three prison types. We shouldn't only focus on two types as seen in textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ó dára! Mo pé a ki í sí lọ́wọ̀ pé a gbà pé ẹ̀yìnkúlé náà sì dára, nitori pé a o lè ṣe ọjọ́ mẹ́ta tí a bà fún ẹ̀yìnkúlé fún ìtọ̀jú.
dialogue.translation: That's good! I think we shouldn't give up until we agree that the system is good, because we can achieve three days of training for authorities.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ran lọ́wọ̀. A máa fún ẹ̀yìnkúlé ìtọ̀jú tí ó dára, àti pé a kó àwọn ìtọ̀jú yìí lọ́wọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìlà-ìmọ̀ rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: I agree. We will provide authorities with good training, and we will put these tools in their hands with their own knowledge.

dialogue.text: Ṣéni lẹ́yìn àwọn ọlọ́na globalization ni a sì gbàgbọ́? Ti a ṣé lọ́dọ̀ rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́, a jẹ́ kò pàtọ̀ bí a ti ṣé rántí.
dialogue.translation: Who actually benefits from globalization? When we look at it closely, it’s not entirely as we might have thought.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Láyọ̀, àwọn ọlọ́na globalization ni a fún nípa àwọn ọmọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ àti àwọn ọkàn déédéé. Ṣé a sì gbàgbọ́ tó fún àwọn oníṣowo?
dialogue.translation: Today, the benefits of globalization are mostly for the elite and the wealthy. Do we really believe it helps business owners?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni! A ti ṣé rántí pàtọ̀ bí àwọn ọlọ́na globalization ṣe ti oṣelu. A jẹ́ kò ni àwọn ọmọ̀ àgbọn àti àwọn ọlọ́na àwọn ogbó.
dialogue.translation: Exactly! We thought globalization would be completely fair. But it hasn’t been for farmers or local industries.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí àyọkà! A sì ti ṣé lọ́dọ̀ fún àwọn àgbẹ́ ọlọ́na àwọn ogbó. Ṣé a tọ̀pẹ́ bá àwọn àgbẹ́ ènìyàn sílẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: Indeed! We’ve also looked into the challenges faced by local industries. Should we just abandon these industries entirely?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kò sì tọ̀pẹ́! A lè ṣéda àwọn àṣẹ́ àti àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ lẹ́yìn àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àgbágbá. Ṣé o gbàgbọ́ tó wà?
dialogue.translation: Not at all! We can create policies and support systems after proper education. Do you believe in that?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbàgbọ́! Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni àwọn àṣẹ́ àti àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ ni a fún láti mú àwọn oníṣowo àti àwọn ọmọ̀ àgbọn pàtọ̀.
dialogue.translation: I believe so! These policies and support systems are exactly what we need to empower businesses and farmers.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o sì ti rántí tó ṣé nípa àwọn àgbá ọmọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ àti àwọn oníṣowo àgbọn? Àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àgbágbá ni a fún láti ṣérọ́ àwọn àṣẹ́ yẹn.
dialogue.translation: Have you also considered the role of educated elites and business owners? Proper education is what we need to implement these policies.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀! A sì fún ẹ̀kọ́ àgbágbá láti jẹ́kún àwọn oníṣowo àti àwọn ọmọ̀ àgbọn. Lẹ́yìn náà, a lè ṣéda àwọn àṣẹ́ àti àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ lẹ́yìn ọkàn.
dialogue.translation: Yes! We provide proper education to empower business owners and farmers. After that, we can create policies and support systems accordingly.

key_phrases.phrase: Ṣéni lẹ́yìn àwọn ọlọ́na globalization ni a sì gbàgbọ́?
key_phrases.translation: Who actually benefits from globalization?

key_phrases.phrase: Mo gbàgbọ́! Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni àwọn àṣẹ́ àti àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ ni a fún láti mú àwọn oníṣowo àti àwọn ọmọ̀ àgbọn pàtọ̀.
key_phrases.translation: I believe so! These policies and support systems are exactly what we need to empower businesses and farmers.

dialogue.translation: Not at first, but do you think children in other countries become similar to us?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Whether children who move to your country then follow the global culture, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbàgbọ́ ní wọn ṣé sí àgbáyé ìlú rẹ̀ sílẹ̀, ṣé o tún rò pé wọn le jẹ́ mọ́ pé wọn ṣélú àwọn ẹ̀yìn?
dialogue.translation: I agree they participate in global culture, but do you think they can realize they are among others?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wọn lẹ́yìn náà ti ṣé sí àwọn ètò àti àwọn àmì, ṣé o tún rò pé wọn yóò ṣégun àti àgbáyé ọ̀dọ̀ wọn sílẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: After that, they engage in systems and institutions, do you think they’ll triumph over their own culture?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo tún rò pé àwọn ẹ̀yìn lọ́dọ̀ wọn ṣé sì ṣégun àti àgbáyé àwọn ọ̀dọ̀ wọn lọ́dọ̀ rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: I also think their peers help them overcome their own culture’s influence.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o tún rò pé àtúkọ́sílẹ̀ àti àwọn ìlú mìíràn lè dá ẹ̀rí àti ìtàn àwọn ọmọdé láyọ̀?
dialogue.translation: Do you think local and foreign cultures can shape children’s true narratives?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbàgbọ́ ní wọn lè dá àti ṣe àgbáyé àti ìtàn ọkàn wọn.
dialogue.translation: I believe they can shape both global narratives and their personal stories.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, àwọn ọmọdé yóò ṣé sí àti ṣégun àti ìtàn àwọn ọkàn wọn ní àwọn ìlú mìíràn.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, children will engage and triumph over their personal stories in foreign lands.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ìwọ ǹkọ́ nípa àwọn olùrànlọ̀wọ́ àgbàgbọnú ní interneti, bí a bá kún láti ṣẹ́gun àwọn álààfin ti a pàtàkù?
dialogue.translation: You often talk about the dangers of the internet, but what if we completely defeat all these sudden threats?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kò dára, bí a bá tó fúnfun ní àwọn idaraya ti a ṣe ní interneti, a ó lè ṣẹ́gun àwọn àlààfin, ṣugbọn àwọn olùrànlọ̀wọ́ àgbàgbọnú yóò dúró lẹ́yìn.
dialogue.translation: Not good, if we leave our data completely unprotected on the internet, we may defeat threats, but the dangers will remain afterwards.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé àwọn ọlọ́gbọ́n lè tun ṣiṣẹ́ nípa àwọn ipa àgbàyé lọ́wọ́ àwọn ajọdún?
dialogue.translation: Can experts also work on global health issues under pressure?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí a bá kúkúrú ní àwọn ipa àgbàyé, a kò ṣẹ́gun púpọ̀, ṣugbọn àwọn ipa àgbàgbọnú ni a yí o lọ́wọ́ gidigidi.
dialogue.translation: If we fake global health issues, we won't achieve much, but real threats must be addressed seriously.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ra pé àwọn olùrànlọ̀wọ́ àgbàgbọnú lè dúró pàtàkù ní àwọn àgbàgbọnú láti ṣẹ́gun àwọn àlààfin.
dialogue.translation: I believe dangers can suddenly remain in cyberspace to threaten our safety.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àwọn àgbàgbọnú kò ṣẹ́gun lẹ́yìn tí a bá ṣe ọgbọn nípa àwọn idaraya wa, nitorí náà ni a o ṣẹ́gun púpọ̀ láti ṣẹ́gun àwọn àlààfin.
dialogue.translation: Dangers won't remain after we act wisely regarding our data, that's why we must succeed greatly in defeating threats.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé àwọn ìtọ́jú àgbàgbọnú lè tún dé èyí tí a ṣe ní 2020?
dialogue.translation: Can cybersecurity measures be as effective as they were in 2020?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kò wúlò, àwọn ìtọ́jú àgbàgbọnú ti tún dé, ṣugbọn àwọn àlààfin pátá sì tún daraya.
dialogue.translation: Not really, cybersecurity measures have improved, but threats have also increased greatly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo ṣẹ́gun púpọ̀ nípa àwọn ohun tí a ṣe ní interneti, ṣugbọn ẹ̀yin kò ṣẹ́gun bí a ti ǹkọ́ pé.
dialogue.translation: I've succeeded greatly in what we do on the internet, but you haven't succeeded as we often claim.

key_phrases.phrase: Bí a bá kún láti ṣẹ́gun àwọn álààfin ti a pàtàkù?
key_phrases.translation: What if we completely defeat all these sudden threats?

key_phrases.phrase: Bí a bá tó fúnfun ní àwọn idaraya ti a ṣe ní interneti, a ó lè ṣẹ́gun àwọn àlààfin.
key_phrases.translation: If we leave our data completely unprotected on the internet, we may defeat threats.

key_phrases.phrase: Àwọn àgbàgbọnú kò ṣẹ́gun lẹ́yìn tí a bá ṣe ọgbọn nípa àwọn idaraya wa.
key_phrases.translation: Dangers won't remain after we act wisely regarding our data.

dialogue.translation: Please, can you give me the strength to continue?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kó ṣé lẹ́nu pàtọ́ lọ́wọ́ mi. Ṣe bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìwé yìí, ẹ̀yin kú kọ́ ní ṣérọ̀.
dialogue.translation: It should be similar to what I have. Start from this book, you all will understand the idea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo mọ́lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo kò sẹ́lẹ̀.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣe o fún mi ní àyọ̀kú ẹ̀kọ́? Mo sì lè ṣélẹ̀ fún ọ̀nà kan.
dialogue.translation: Will you give me a piece of advice? I can show you a way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, múra, mo fún ọ̀nà àti lágbára mi.
dialogue.translation: Please, wait, I will give you the path and my strength.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo dúpé, ẹ̀yin sì ṣèlẹ̀ lẹ́nu ìwé mi.
dialogue.translation: Thank you, you all have understood sufficiently through my book.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ṣe kí o máa bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ àwọn àgbọ́n rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Yes indeed, you should start with your own arguments.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo kò pàtọ́ lọ́wọ̀ ọ̀nà àgbọ́n mi, ṣùgbọ́n mo fún ọ̀nà àti lágbára.
dialogue.translation: I am not the same as my argument path, but I will give you the path and strength.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ẹ ku iṣẹ́, mo sì fi ìwẹ̀ ń bá ọ.
dialogue.translation: Goodbye, I will follow you with my heart.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tání, ṣe àwọn ọmọdé nínú ilú mìíràn ti wọ̀nyí wọ̀nyí kú láti ṣèlẹ̀ nínú àpá?
dialogue.translation: Tani, do all the children in this area die from malaria?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, kú níṣé ni? Kéré ṣémi nínú àpá nílà wọ̀nyí lọ́wọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé.
dialogue.translation: Please, what does it mean to die from malaria? It's not that common among children here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ọjọ́ ọṣẹ̀ gbọ̀dọ̀ gba ìpínlẹ̀sẹ̀ lọ́wọ̀ àwọn èèyàn?
dialogue.translation: Since the beginning of the dry season, has the government taken action to help the people?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tọ́un ti dé tẹ́lẹ̀ láti wà nínú àgbẹ̀jó àti àwọn ọlọ́gbọ́n nínú ilú. Ṣèlẹ̀ nínú àpá nílà sì jẹ́ kéré.
dialogue.translation: He himself just arrived to inspect the hospitals and traditional leaders in the area. The malaria cases here are just minor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣémi, àwọn ọmọdé nínú àpá nílà wọ̀nyí sì gbọ̀dọ̀ kú ní gbogbo ààyè̩?
dialogue.translation: But, shouldn't all children in this area die from malaria every year?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gbọ̀dọ̀ kú nnáà? Ìpínlẹ̀sẹ̀ ti gba àwọn ọmọdé lọ́wọ̀ àpá ní ṣẹ́gun.
dialogue.translation: Should they die like that? The government has taken care of the children against malaria effectively.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nítorí náà, àwọn èèyàn nínú àpá nílà sì wà dára ní gbogbo ààyè̩?
dialogue.translation: So, are people in this area doing well in all aspects?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Òun ló sì jẹ́ gbọ́gbọ́n. Àwọn èèyàn sì nínú ẹ̀bùn lọ́wọ̀ ọgbọn àti ìpínlẹ̀sẹ̀ nínú àpá.
dialogue.translation: Yes, that is wise. People are in good health due to wisdom and government support in this area.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo kó àwọn ìrẹ̀sì àti àwọn àkọ́kọ́ ìtọ́jú ní àpáàrọ̀ kan tó wà ní ẹ̀kọ́ àti ìtàn Ìlà-O̩rọ̀ láti lọ́wọ́ àwọn onísẹ̀ye.
dialogue.translation: I gathered historical and early texts in a single volume that exist in literature and oral tradition from the perspective of the colonizers.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣé o bẹ̀rẹ̀ láàárín àwọn àkọ́kọ́ àgbáyé àti àwọn àtúnṣe? Nítorí àwọn àtúnṣe jẹ́ yàtọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn àkọ́kọ́.
dialogue.translation: Did you include the interaction between the original texts and those that were altered? Because the altered texts are different from the originals.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣẹ́, mo wà ní ẹ̀bẹ̀ láti fún àwọn ẹ̀yìn ìtàn ní ìmọ̀ràn tó jọ̀ fún àwọn ńlọ́wọ́ àwọn àdìrẹ́.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I included a section to provide context for texts that suit the works of anti-colonial writers.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Báwo ni àwọn ẹ̀yìn ìtàn náà ṣélẹ̀ fún àwọn àdìrẹ́ láti kó àwọn ìtàn wọ̀nyí sí ọ̀nà àdìe?
dialogue.translation: How do these contextual texts only help anti-colonial writers to frame these stories in a new way?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nítorí àwọn àdìrẹ́ gbà àwọn ìtàn wọ̀nyí ní ìmọ̀ràn tó wà ní ẹ̀kọ́ àti ìtàn-ìlú láti jẹ́ àwọn àtúnṣe mímọ̀.
dialogue.translation: Because the anti-colonial writers accept these stories with context rooted in education and oral tradition to create authentic transformations.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Báwo ni àwọn àtúnṣe mímọ̀ náà ṣé wà nípa àwọn àkọ́kọ́ ilé-ilú?
dialogue.translation: How do these authentic transformations relate to the original local texts?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Àwọn àtúnṣe náà jẹ́ yàtọ̀ lọ́wọ̀ àwọn àkọ́kọ́, ṣugbọn a ṣé àwọn kíkà ni àtúnṣe wọ̀nyí ṣé àti ìmọ̀ràn tó wà ní àpáàrọ̀ náà.
dialogue.translation: These transformations are different in the eyes of the originals, but we see the differences in this transformation and the context that exists in this volume as well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbà pé àpáàrọ̀ yìí yẹ́ àwọn àdìrẹ́ láti fún àwọn ọmọdé láti mọ̀ ìtàn-ìlú láti mú àwọn àtúnṣe mímọ̀.
dialogue.translation: I agree that this volume will help anti-colonial writers teach the younger generation about oral tradition to embrace authentic transformations.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Àwọn ìtàn wọ̀nyí jẹ́ àwọn àlọ̀gbà tó wà ní ọ̀nà àdìe fún ìtàn-ìlú àti ìtàn àti ìtàn-ẹ̀kọ́.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. These stories are the foundations that exist in a new path for oral tradition, literature, and educational narratives.
